checkpoints.description: Task 'neurocore-operator-controls' completed successfully.
[1/3] Add opt-in per-node retry policies with bounded exponential backoff and per-node timeouts, wired through both normal and bridge node execution; then document, verify and ship

impact_assessment.why: A transient provider timeout or connection drop currently fails the whole node (and often the run) with no recovery, and node latency has no per-node ceiling
impact_assessment.benefits: Bounded, deterministic recovery from transient node failures without duplicating side effects by default, plus an optional per-node time ceiling
impact_assessment.risks: contract: node config gains retry_* and timeout_seconds, execution budget spending moves into the attempt; dependency: none; concurrency: retries happen in the same task; state: none beyond flow JSON
impact_assessment.mitigation: Opt-in defaults (attempts=1), transient-only classification, budget-aware attempts, failing-first tests for both paths

checkpoints.description: Task 'neurocore-node-retry' completed successfully.
[1/2] Add bounded per-node latency history with p99 stall detection, metrics/logging hooks, a debug-mode report route, and per-attempt timing in the flow runner; then verify and ship

impact_assessment.why: A stalled node was invisible until the whole flow timed out, and there was no per-node-type latency baseline to distinguish a normal slow node from an outlier
impact_assessment.benefits: Operators can see degrading node types and the exact flow/node of a stall without changing run behaviour
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new debug route and metrics keys; dependency: none; concurrency: thread-safe monitor with bounded state; state: process-local history only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bounded history and keys, observational-only detection, injected observability hooks to avoid an import cycle, failing-first tests
